subject: Invoice submission policy and minimal header specification
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmecorp.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice intake: portal preferred but email fallback questions

Hi Nikhil / Kimberly,

We're starting vendor onboarding for the Q2 integration with Redwood. Our finance team prefers to push invoices through your portal, but a handful of legacy vendors will keep sending email attachments for the first 60 days. Before we flip the portal to 'required' on our side we need a very small, machine-friendly spec for email fallbacks so our accounts payable system can auto-ingest.

Two quick asks:
- Can you provide a minimal CSV header spec (or acceptable PDF/attachment naming convention) that we can enforce at our side?
- How do you expect multiple PO numbers to be represented (single invoice with multiple PO lines vs. separate invoices)?

Attached is one of the legacy sample invoices so you can see what our vendors currently send.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Procurement Ops
Acme Corp

Attachment: sample_invoice_acme.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice intake: portal preferred but email fallback questions

Hi Maria — thanks for the sample. Portal-first is ideal; email fallback is fine if we get a small, consistent payload. I've sketched a minimal header set that our ingest pipeline requires and attached a one-line CSV example. High level: portal wins for attachments + structured fields, but email fallback must include one of two guarantees so we can auto-apply the invoice to the right PO(s):

1) A CSV attachment that contains a header row with the fields we list below, OR
2) A single PDF/attachment named with the subject token and a matching email subject line (see "subject token" guidance).

Minimal CSV header proposal (attached file: redwood-minimal-invoice-headers-v1.csv):
- vendor_name
- vendor_tax_id (VAT/GST where applicable)
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- invoice_total_amount (in vendor currency)
- currency (ISO3)
- po_number (if multiple, provide multiple rows each with the same invoice_number)
- line_description (optional)
- line_amount (optional)
- tax_amount (optional)

Notes on multiple POs: our pipeline treats each CSV row as a single PO-to-invoice mapping. So if one invoice covers PO-100 and PO-101, vendors should include two rows with the same invoice_number but different po_number values and per-row line_amounts that sum to the invoice_total_amount. This is the simplest way to keep reconciliation deterministic.

Subject token guidance for PDF/email fallbacks:
- Email subject must contain: "Invoice: <VendorShortName> / INV-<invoice_number> / PO-<po_number>"
- Attachment filename must match: VendorShortName_INV-invoice_number_PO-po_number.pdf

Questions for you:
- Do your legacy vendors have the capacity to add a small CSV? If not, we'll rely on the subject token + filename convention and accept a single PDF.
- Any jurisdictional tax fields we should add to the header for Acme-specific processing?

I'll loop Jordan in for approval on the acceptable fallback SLA.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Vendor Onboarding (Procurement Integrations)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-minimal-invoice-headers-v1.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmecorp.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@acmecorp.com
Date: Thu, 23 Feb 2028 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice intake: portal preferred but email fallback questions

Thanks Nikhil — that layout is helpful and very actionable. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Most legacy vendors cannot produce CSVs reliably. We'll aim to add the subject token + filename convention to our vendor instructions and run a 60-day grace period.
- For invoices that cover multiple POs, we will update vendor instructions to require duplicate rows as you recommended when a CSV is available; otherwise, vendors should put PO numbers comma-separated in the subject token (we understand this is less ideal).
- Tax fields: Acme requires a breakdown of tax_type (e.g., VAT/GST) and tax_rate (percent) when taxes are present. Can those be optional columns in your CSV?

I'll plan to push vendor comms early next week if Jordan approves the fallback policy and the subject convention.

Cheers,
Maria

Attachment: (none)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmecorp.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Feb 2028 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice intake: portal preferred but email fallback questions

Maria — quick operational notes from our side:

- We can accept tax_type and tax_rate as optional columns; add them to the CSV spec. Please ask vendors to include vendor_tax_id where applicable.
- If vendors send a single PDF and list multiple PO numbers in the subject token separated by commas, our team will attempt to auto-split to multiple PO mappings but will flag the invoice for manual review if totals don't reconcile exactly. Expect longer processing latency for those.
- For file naming robustness, ask vendors to avoid spaces and special characters; use underscores. Example: Acme_INV-2028-0098_PO-12345,12346.pdf (we will parse the comma list).

Operational cutover suggestion:
- Day 0: portal enabled and recommended; vendor comms say portal preferred.
- Day 30: enforce subject token for email fallback (we will reject emails missing the token).
- Day 60: portal-only for new invoices; legacy exceptions require support ticket.

I'll defer SLA exception approval to Jordan (copying him).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice intake: portal preferred but email fallback questions

Maria — thanks for the quick turnaround and for agreeing to the subject/token approach for legacy vendors. Approved on our end:

- Redwoods accepts the proposed minimal CSV headers plus optional tax_type and tax_rate.
- We will implement the 30/60-day enforcement cadence Kimberly outlined.
- We will provide a one-page vendor instruction doc and a short SLA note (attachment) you can publish to your suppliers.

Next steps:
- Nikhil: publish the one-pager and a short inbound email template.
- Maria: confirm go-live date for vendor comms (we recommend Monday, 2028-03-04 so we can do a weekend deploy and outreach).

I'll attach the intake SOP we use internally for your reference.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice-intake-sop-v1.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
